request.recordSelection: argument one zero selects HNDL; nonzero selects HNDR

fields.startIndex: argument three signed low word minus one
fields.endIndex: argument four signed low word minus one
fields.currentIndex: argument five signed low word minus one
fields.flagByte: argument six low byte with bit three cleared
fields.positiveStepFloatWord: argument seven raw float word when greater than zero

request.provenBehavior: Resolves the selected HNDL/HNDR record, selects the exact controller range for argument two, initializes and clamps the authored index interval, clears flag bit three, applies a positive playback step, and starts the optional native transition when argument eight is positive. Missing objects or records are native no-ops and a missing range produces the native zero-range controller state.

control.recordSelection: argument one zero selects HNDL; nonzero selects HNDR

modes.0: argument three's signed-low-word truth value sets or clears the argument-four low-byte mask; direction bit one transitions clamp the opposite range endpoint to the current endpoint exactly as the native controller
modes.1: writes argument three's raw float word to the playback step only when it is greater than zero

control.provenBehavior: Dispatches only control modes zero and one. Other modes and missing objects or records are native no-ops.

evidenceBoundary: HNDL and HNDR remain literal native associated-record tags.
Raw argument words are retained; only the native signed-word, byte, and float interpretations are applied.
Controller range lookup remains an injected record inventory rather than a guessed animation mapping.
The browser presentation adapter remains separate from this canonical controller-state contract.
